source_text: Opponents, often emphasizing bodily integrity and autonomy, contend that non-therapeutic infant circumcision constitutes an irreversible alteration without consent, potentially diminishing penile sensitivity and representing an ethical infringement, with calls to defer the decision until adulthood.
